book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: ما بدي أتعب حالي بالتذكر، بس بتذكر مسا خريفي، مطر، بشارع بموسكو.
sentences.en: I need not strain my memory, but I remember an autumn evening, rain, in a Moscow street.

sentences.ar: قدام بيت كبير عليه لافتة: مطعم.
sentences.en: Before a big house with a sign: Restaurant.

sentences.ar: وأنا واقف، عمري تمان سنين، جنب أبوي.
sentences.en: And I stood, eight years old, beside my father.

sentences.ar: أبوي بمعطف صيفي مهترئ، وقبعة، وجزمة فيها ثقوب، وبيرجف.
sentences.en: My father in a threadbare summer coat, a cap, boots with holes, shivering.

sentences.ar: من خمس شهور بيدور على شغل بموسكو، وما لقى.
sentences.en: For five months he had been looking for work in Moscow, and found none.
And that day, he had decided to beg.
For the first time.
But he did not know how.

sentences.ar: كل ما يمرق حدا، يفتح تمه، ويسكر، ويحمر، ويسكت.
sentences.en: Every time someone passed, he opened his mouth, closed it, went red, and was silent.

sentences.ar: وأنا جنبه، جوعان لدرجة إن الأرض بتدور.
sentences.en: And I beside him, so hungry the ground was spinning.

sentences.ar: وقريت اللافتة، من فوق لتحت، لأني تعلمت أقرا من شهر.
sentences.en: And I read the sign, top to bottom, because I had learned to read a month before.
Restaurant.
And beneath it in white letters: oysters.
I said: papa, what does oysters mean?
And my father did not hear.
He was watching the people.

sentences.ar: قلت كمان مرة، وقال، بلا ما يتطلع فيّ: حيوان.
sentences.en: I said it again, and he said, without looking at me: an animal.
Lives in the sea.
They eat it.

sentences.ar: وتخيلت حيوان، زي الضفدع، بيطلع من قوقعة، ببحر بعيد.
sentences.en: And I imagined an animal, like a frog, coming out of a shell, in a far sea.
I said: how do they eat it?
He said: alive.
In its shell.
And they squeeze lemon on it.
Alive!
And for a moment, I was disgusted, and imagined it moving in my mouth.

sentences.ar: بس بعدين، الجوع أقوى، والصورة تغيرت.
sentences.en: But then, hunger was stronger, and the picture changed.
The animal became delicious.
And its shell delicious.
And even the lemon.

sentences.ar: وصرت أشم ريحة بحر، وبدي آكل.
sentences.en: And I began smelling the sea, and wanting to eat.

sentences.ar: وقلت بصوت عالي، بلا ما أقصد: محار!
sentences.en: And said out loud, without meaning to: oysters!
Give me oysters!
And held out my hand.
And my father whispered: God, he is begging.
My son is begging.

sentences.ar: ووقف اتنين، لابسين قبعات عالية، وضحكوا.
sentences.en: And two men stopped, in top hats, and laughed.
One said: the boy wants oysters!
Ha ha!
Does he eat oysters?
Let us see!
And they took me by the hand into the restaurant.

sentences.ar: ضو، وناس، ودفا، وريحة أكل، وطاولة.
sentences.en: Light, people, warmth, the smell of food, a table.

sentences.ar: وحطوا قدامي صحن، وعليه أشيا بيضا، لزجة، بقواقع.
sentences.en: And put before me a plate, with white things on it, slimy, in shells.
And I ate.
Without chewing.
Shells and all.
And the people laughing.
And it tasted of sea, and salt, and something alive.
And I ate ten, and then I did not know.

sentences.ar: وطلعت، وأبوي واقف بالمطر، بيتطلع بالباب، وما دخل.
sentences.en: And I came out, and my father stood in the rain, looking at the door, and had not come in.

sentences.ar: وطول الليل، بالأوضة اللي كنا نسكنها، كنت أتقيأ، وأتعذب من العطش.
sentences.en: And all night, in the room where we lodged, I was sick, and tortured by thirst.

sentences.ar: وأبوي قاعد على السرير، بيمشي رايح جاي، وبيقول لحاله:
sentences.en: And my father sat on the bed, walked back and forth, and said to himself:
Ten roubles.
If I had ten roubles.
Only ten roubles.

sentences.ar: وما فهمت وقتها ليش هو اللي بيبكي، وأنا اللي أكلت.
sentences.en: And I did not understand then why he was the one crying, and I the one who had eaten.
